item.tib: sku gsum rig 'dus dran pa drag phur dam sri kun sgrol gnam lcags dbal 'khor gsang ba dgongs 'dus las bzlog gzhung dam sri byad ma rang gshed dbab pa'i spu gri 'khor lo
item.coloph: zhes pas bzlog (zlog) pa'i las byang 'di'ang snyigs dus kyi sngags kyi ming 'dzin tshe dbang 'gyur med byang chub rol pa rtsal zhes 'bod pa la/ mkha' 'gro zab bcud brgyud bzhin dgongs pa'i klong nas don gyi brda las phab pas dge ba'o//
